title: Rasmalai and Mango eggless cakes for Parramatta and Westmead families
summary:
Fifteen flavours. Two of them, Rasmalai and Mango, are missing from most cake counters in Parramatta and Westmead — because eggless batter makes both harder to bind, and most bakeries don't bother.

We've made both in Harris Park since 2019. Rasmalai carries cardamom and reduced milk through the sponge, not just the icing. Mango is built into the batter — not poured over vanilla and called mango.

It's still eggless. It still tastes like Rasmalai.

Starts at $39.99 for a 6-inch, serves 6–8. 48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes. Pickup from Wigram Street, minutes from Parramatta CBD and Westmead.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
keywords: eggless cake that actually tastes like Rasmalai
